title: Task 4: Regenerate and verify canonical SRD pack
description:
Objective:
Regenerate and review the canonical SRD pack, pin the new coverage, update documentation, and run all repository gates.

Files:
- Modify: packages/core/test/srdGeneratedPack.test.ts
- Modify: packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/manifest.json
- Modify: packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/records.json
- Modify: packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/README.md
- Modify: docs/audits/srd-5.1-rules-section-coverage.md

Steps:
1. RED: Update canonical regression expectations to rule=166 and table=8; pin exact five new rule keys and five new table keys/names, representative row data, source pages, Objects body landmarks, and absence of table-row/neighbor-section contamination. Run npx vitest run packages/core/test/srdGeneratedPack.test.ts and observe failure against the old committed pack.
2. GREEN: Run npm run import:dnd5e-srd -- --out packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1 to regenerate from the pinned PDF.
3. Review git diff for every canonical change. Confirm the intended ten new records and explicitly inspect any incidental existing-record text changes caused by the generic extractor fix; add a regression assertion or adjust the extraction fix if unrelated churn is not demonstrably corrective.
4. Update README table/rule counts, section-anchor/reference-table coverage, tests, and regeneration notes. Mark Madness/Objects coverage imported in the audit document.
5. Run npm run audit:rules-pack -- packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1 and npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack; expect no suspicious records and exact importer/pack equality.
6. Run npm run verify:worktree; expect all formatting, checks, typecheck, and tests to pass.
design: The generated pack remains derived output. Baselines are updated only after reviewing the importer result. The canonical regression block owns exact table/rule keys and body fidelity, while verify:dnd5e-srd-pack proves byte equality with a fresh import.
acceptance_criteria:
- Canonical pack contains 166 rules and 8 tables, including exactly the ten new reviewed records.
- Pack audit and verify:dnd5e-srd-pack pass.
- Importer README and coverage audit describe the implemented behavior and counts.
- Any extractor-caused changes to existing records are explicitly reviewed and regression-covered.
- npm run verify:worktree passes.
close_reason: Canonical pack regenerated and reviewed; exact 166-rule/8-table coverage, audit, fresh-import verification, and full worktree verification passed.
